title: Shopping list generation
lead: Build list items from the confirmed plan, aggregating quantities (L2).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** pantry subtraction (Phase 2); runout or "low" staples (S39); one-tap staples (S25); UI.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Turning a plan into a list automatically is most of the value of the MVP. Staples are added by hand with one tap (L3, S25) and are only kept here when the list is regenerated.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body:
None. The list interview is done (ADR 0019, ADR 0020). Owner decisions: 2026-11-04, ADR 0019 (S15): sum the same item across recipes within one unit dimension, never across volume and weight; cans count as cans; basics (salt, pepper, oil) never appear automatically unless a staple that is low; category order per ADR 0019. 2026-11-04, ADR 0020 (S23): a range puts its high end (qty_max) on the list; an alternatives line lists its first choice only; quantities shown are the recipe quantities, summed within a unit dimension, with the source recipes kept on each line; free-text items are allowed and sort after the categorized items; the list resets with a manual 'Ordered' button and checked items are struck through until 'Clear' (those two belong to S25).

Owner decisions: 2026-11-05, spec-check answers: (1) basics are the items that have a staple row: generation skips plan lines whose item has a staple row (ADR 0019 ties basics to 'marked as a staple'), with a test, no schema change; (2) a converted sum shows the largest unit among the contributing lines (2 tbsp + 1 cup = 1.125 cup), with factors for tsp, tbsp, cup, ml and l, and for oz, lb, g and kg; (3) regenerating replaces the plan items with the union of every confirmed week whose Saturday is not before today; (4) a plan item stays checked on regenerate only if its summed quantity is unchanged, otherwise it comes back unchecked. (5) The Check line was tightened by the assistant, following the spec check's recommendation, without a separate owner answer: replace the vague Check with the unit tests (tests.test_list_generate, all passing), ruff check . and ruff format --check . exiting 0; the 'matches what the owner would have written by hand' claim is dropped because the slice has no UI to show a real week (the owner checks a real week after S25).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/larder/shopping/generate.py`
- `src/larder/shopping_db.py` (SQL: plan ingredient lines with `qty_max` and alternatives; list item writes)
- `tests/test_list_generate.py`

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Collect ingredient lines from the confirmed plan; skip optional and non-food ones per ADR 0020.
2. Group by item; convert and sum within a dimension (ADR 0019). A range uses the bound ADR 0020 names; alternatives follow ADR 0020 (S59 columns).
3. Merge with existing list items: generated items are tagged `source=plan` and replaced on regenerate; manual and staple items are kept.
4. Subscribe to the `plan_confirmed` / plan-edit hooks.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Generation tests pass; the list for a real week matches what the owner would have written by hand.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Add shopping list generation from the confirmed plan (S24).
